questionText: Installing 'Floating Solar PV' panels on reservoirs and irrigation canals (such as the 100 MW floating solar project at Ramagundam, Telangana) provides which dual environmental benefits?

options.text: Conserves valuable terrestrial land, reduces water evaporative losses from the reservoir, while the natural water cooling effect increases solar panel electrical efficiency

topic: Progressive Stages of Water-Induced Soil Erosion
questionText:
Arrange the evolutionary stages of soil erosion by water in order of increasing visual prominence and structural devastation:
(I) Raindrop / Splash erosion: kinetic impact of falling raindrops dislodges and shatters soil aggregates
(II) Sheet erosion: uniform superficial peeling of a thin topsoil layer by unchanneled overland runoff
(III) Rill erosion: runoff concentrates into numerous miniature, centimeter-deep finger-like rivulets
(IV) Gully erosion: rills coalesce into deep, steep-sided channels that cannot be smoothed over by ordinary plowing

Choose the correct chronological/logical sequence from the options given below:

options.text: II -> I -> III -> IV
options.mistakeAnalysis: Incorrect option. Inverts the governing property or boundary condition.

options.text: IV -> II -> III -> I
options.mistakeAnalysis: Incorrect option. Applies an adjacent or reciprocal mathematical relation.

options.text: I -> II -> III -> IV
options.mistakeAnalysis: Correct answer. Accurately identifies the verified NCERT principle for Progressive Stages of Water-Induced Soil Erosion.

options.text: I -> III -> II -> IV
options.mistakeAnalysis: Incorrect option. Confuses related NCERT concepts or attributes.

detailedSolution:
Detailed Solution:
According to NCERT principles for Development and Environment (Progressive Stages of Water-Induced Soil Erosion):
I -> II -> III -> IV

Detailed Analysis:
Erosion progresses systematically from raindrop splash to sheet erosion, shallow rills, and finally destructive deep gullies.
Hence, Option A is correct.

Therefore, option (C) is the correct answer.
